_comment: Controlled vocabulary for Stage 4 name/term correction. Seeded ahead of Stage 4 build-out -- known_asr_variants are observed mishearings to correct on sight; add more as they turn up across sources (Zoom transcript, YouTube captions, Whisper).

terms.notes: Observed in Zoom transcript for Salon 92 ('text freshness', 'text brush') and YouTube auto-captions for Salon 20 ('tech express system'), consistently right before 'Salon'. Watch for this pattern specifically before the word 'Salon', across every ASR source.

Confirmed via full-corpus survey 2026-09-18 (647 legit "expressionism"/"impressionism" references excluded by not matching those bare words -- only tech/tex/tax/text-prefixed and merged forms are misspellings of this term).
